proposed_comments.title: Synchronize the reloaded snap setting

proposed_comments.body:
### Synchronize the reloaded snap setting

**Severity:** `high`

The settings watcher reloads this value while the low-level mouse hook reads it during a drag. Keeping it as a plain `bool` creates a C++ data race, which can produce undefined behavior when the option is changed while Grab and Move is active. Store the setting in an atomic value so reloads and hook reads are synchronized.

```suggestion
static std::atomic_bool g_snapToEdges{ true };
```

proposed_comments.title: Evaluate the snap target at button-up

confidence.rationale: The release branch consumes g_snapArmed, which is updated only in the throttled mouse-move handler. The changed code directly exposes both the stale-state path and synchronous cross-process calls.

proposed_comments.title: Use monitor bounds for snap-zone detection

confidence.rationale: MONITORINFO distinguishes rcMonitor from rcWork. The implementation uses rcWork for both hit-testing and placement, so a docked taskbar shifts the active threshold away from the physical edge.

proposed_comments.title: Do not preview unsupported snap operations

confidence.rationale: The existing right-button resize path already rejects windows without WS_THICKFRAME, while this changed drag path directly calls SetWindowPos or ShowWindow for every computed target.
